messages:
Ben (Sales): Hey team, kicking off a POC with StrataCloud. They want a short-lived POC workspace where engineers can call hosted APIs, but ops wants a Dedicated pool option if perf looks good. Need guidance on invite flows and least-priv privilege — can we do ephemeral keys + role mapping?
Jordan (SE): Yep. Two options: 1) Hosted API keys in a shared POC workspace with scoped API keys (ephemeral, token TTL). 2) Dedicated pool reserved for the POC—longer lead time (~2 business days) and KMS for keys.
Ben (Sales): Customer specifically asked: "only devs should call the API, ops should not see keys, and we need audit logs for every request." Can we satisfy that with hosted?
Jordan (SE): Hosted can meet that: create workspace, invite users with roles, issue short-lived keys for dev role. Audit logs are available in Console (per-request with token id). Ops can get metrics but not raw key access.
Nidhi (Security): A few constraints from their compliance team: (1) KMS-backed keys for Dedicated, (2) 30-day logs retention min, (3) SSO + SCIM for user sync. Hosted POC will need a signed AUP and data processing addendum. :lock:
Maria (Product): Note on roles: we currently surface: Viewer, Developer, Admin, Billing. For least privilege, give devs Developer, ops Monitoring-only via Viewer + route-level dashboards. We can create a temporary custom role if needed but that needs prod config change.
Ben (Sales): Can we create ephemeral API keys scoped to a single route/model and auto-revoke after 72h? Customer wants timebox keys.
Jordan (SE): Yes — use the admin API snippet below to mint scoped ephemeral key (TTL secs). Example:
```
POST /v1/workspaces/:id/keys
{ "scopes": ["models:generate:xyz", "routes:read:my-route"], "ttl_seconds": 259200 }
```
Response contains `key_id` and `secret` — store in vault or give to devs via secure link.
Nidhi (Security): For Hosted: confirm we can tie those keys to audit events with `key_id`. Also confirm we can rotate/revoke immediately.
Jordan (SE): Confirmed — Console and audit API surfaces `key_id` on each request. Revoke call: `DELETE /v1/workspaces/:id/keys/:key_id`. Revoke takes effect instantly.
Maria (Product): Dedicated pool notes: provisioning request needs pool size, region, and whether KMS/HSM required. Also need to know whether they want model pinning (pin to specific version) — that affects rollback strategy.
Ben (Sales): Customer asks about least-priv for invites: ops leads (2 people) should be Billing + Viewer; devs (4 people) Developer; SE (1) Admin for the duration. Is that a reasonable mapping?
Nidhi (Security): That mapping looks fine. Add requirement: all accounts must be SSO-enforced and we should enable MFA. Also capture periodic invites audit: who invited whom — Console export or API available.
Jordan (SE): I'll prepare a one-page runbook for the POC with steps: create workspace, enable SSO, create roles, mint ephemeral keys, provide dashboard links, and, if requested, submit Dedicated pool request (I'll attach sample infra form).
deploy-bot: Dedicated pool request #POC-327 queued; ETA 2d.
Ben (Sales): Perfect. Jordan — can you drop the runbook draft here by EOD? I’ll loop in StrataCloud and legal for DPA.
Jordan (SE): On it. Draft by 18:00 PST. Will include the API snippets and the minimum perms table.
Nidhi (Security): Also adding checklist: KMS yes/no, log retention, SCIM config, DPA signed. I'll ping legal once we have the DPA draft.
Ben (Sales): Thanks all :thumbsup:
